_why: 3.4 Restrained on the player: a fighter caught in a net (set directly, standing in for the Net ability still to come) cannot move, the swordsman's attacks have advantage (Restrained), and the fighter's own swing has disadvantage (Restrained). Break Free is an Athletics check against the stored DC 10; a success ends the condition and gives back the round's movement. Seeded, with refresh.
